title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace
walkthrough:
You open the app at any page while signed out and are redirected to a sign-in screen. It is a single centered card on an otherwise empty page. At the top of the card is the product brand "ANDS Studio" with a small dot mark, then the heading "Sign in" and one line of grey subtext: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace."

The card has two labeled fields: "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password". Below them are two buttons: a primary "Sign in →" (disabled until both fields are filled) and a plain-text toggle, "New client? Create a workspace". Pressing Enter in the password field also submits. While submitting, the button reads "Working…". If sign-in fails, a red notice box appears above the buttons showing the server's error text.

Clicking "New client? Create a workspace" switches the same card into signup mode. The heading changes to "Create your workspace" and the subtext to "One workspace per client company — dossiers, documents and filings stay isolated." A third field appears above the others: "Company / client name" (placeholder "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). The primary button now reads "Create workspace →" and the toggle reads "Have an account? Sign in". There is no email verification step, password-confirmation field, or stated password rules on this screen; there is also no "forgot password" link.

On success (either mode) you are returned to the page you originally tried to open; if you came straight to the sign-in screen you land on the dossier manager by default. On the dossier manager, a top bar shows the brand "ANDS Studio" with the suffix "· dossier manager", then a chip with your email and workspace name plus a "Sign out" button, and navigation chips: "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", and "Guided journey →".

The main area is headed "Your product dossiers" with a "New dossier +" button on the right and an explanatory line saying a Dossier ID is the permanent file for one product at Health Canada. As a new user you see the empty state: "No dossiers yet. Create one to start building a submission."

Clicking "New dossier +" (which toggles to "Cancel") opens an inline card with two fields: "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456") and "Product name" (placeholder "Drugazole 10 mg tablet"), plus a "Create & open →" button ("Creating…" while busy). You must already know your dossier ID and its required format — one lowercase letter followed by 6–7 digits; anything else is rejected with the message "Dossier ID must be one letter + 6–7 digits (e.g. e123456)". On success you are taken straight into that dossier's Module 1 workspace.
